categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: medical imaging equipment and industrial non-destructive testing (NDT) equipment. Its medical imaging products include digital color Doppler ultrasound systems, portable digital radiography (DR) devices, and X-ray equipment. The industrial segment focuses on ultrasonic NDT devices used in sectors like aerospace, energy, and transportation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced ultrasound imaging technologies including real-time 3D imaging, elasticity imaging, contrast-enhanced ultrasound, and phased-array ultrasonic testing. It integrates AI, cloud computing, 5G, and big data for intelligent diagnostics and remote services. Production employs ERP and MES systems for automated, standardized manufacturing with proprietary core circuit designs and software algorithms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, medical research institutions, emergency rescue teams, military, and industrial clients in aerospace, nuclear power, and energy sectors. The company serves both domestic Chinese markets and over 100 countries globally, including the US, Europe, Japan, Russia, Brazil, Mexico, Turkey, and India.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover China extensively with marketing centers in Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Shanghai, and Beijing. Overseas markets include North America, Europe, Asia, and emerging markets along the Belt and Road Initiative. The company has subsidiaries in the US, Hong Kong, and multiple Chinese cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream and downstream in the supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of finished medical imaging and industrial NDT equipment. It controls core component development such as ultrasound probes and software, while some raw materials and parts are outsourced or procured externally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing multi-modal imaging systems, specialized ultrasound diagnostics, portable and shield-free DR devices, and automated NDT solutions. R&D emphasizes AI integration, cloud platforms, surgical navigation, and remote diagnostics. The company also pursues international certification and standards leadership, and plans to expand through technology innovation and acquisitions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of medical imaging devices and industrial NDT equipment. Sales are conducted via a combination of distributor (majority) and direct sales channels, primarily on a buyout basis. The company also earns income from government subsidies and financial investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in ultrasound diagnostics and industrial NDT in China, competing with international giants like GE and Philips in high-end markets. It has made significant progress in closing the technology gap and is recognized globally as a key ultrasound supplier. Its products are well-regarded for clinical image quality and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 375.8 million, a 15.09% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 145.6 million, up 26.12%. Total assets reached about RMB 1 billion, growing nearly 20%. The company maintains strong cash flow and continues to invest over 13% of revenue in R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes proprietary core technologies, including self-developed ultrasound probes and integrated imaging systems, offering high image quality and intelligent diagnostic capabilities. Its multi-modal imaging solutions and portable, shield-free DR devices address unmet clinical and emergency needs. The integration of AI and cloud services enhances diagnostic accuracy and accessibility, differentiating it from competitors.
